messages:
Derek: Postmortem merged — thanks all. Quick follow-up: we need owners + ETAs for customer-facing items: (1) status page language, (2) 72h incident summary, (3) policy on sharing full RCAs with customers who ask. Can we pick owners by EOD?
Priya: I can take the 72h customer summary. Will draft a plain-language one-pager and share for review by tomorrow AM.
Samir: I can own the status page copy. Quick question: do we want the status page to mention underlying cause (cache eviction) or keep it high-level?
Elena: Legal here — for full RCA sharing, we need a standard consent matrix and a redaction checklist. I can't sign off on sharing raw logs/raw artifacts; we should offer a redacted RCA or an NDA route for full materials.
incident-bot: Created action tracker entry ACTION-4721 and linked postmortem: https://go/reports/ACTION-4721 
Derek: Proposed splits: Priya = 72h summary (ETA +24h), Samir = status page (ETA +8h), Elena = RCA-sharing policy + template (ETA +48h). If that works, I'll add to the postmortem checklist and ping infra for mitigation owner.
Priya: noted. I'll use the customer-friendly template from last quarter and include a tl:dr, impact, timeline, mitigation, and "what we're doing next" section.
Samir: Draft statuspage copy (v0):
```
We experienced degraded request throughput for a subset of customers due to an internal cache eviction which caused additional load on downstream workers. Full service restored after failover at 14:37 UTC. We’re implementing safeguards to avoid similar evictions.
```
Samir: Keeping it concise — include timestamps and impacted regions?
Priya: add region note: APAC affected 14:12–14:40 UTC. Also add a sentence: "We do not have evidence of data exfiltration."
Elena: For RCA sharing policy: default = public incident summary + status page. Full RCA available on request following review + redaction +, if necessary, NDA. I'll post a template with checkboxes for redaction items (PII, internal IPs, raw logs).
Derek: Good. Samir can you add the statuspage copy to the draft page and ping ops to schedule the update? Priya please wire the 72h summary into ACTION-4721. Elena, please attach the RCA-sharing one-pager to ACTION-4721 when ready.
Samir: Will do — I'll also flag the incident with recurring-pattern tag: "cache-eviction-series" and recommend adding a monitoring threshold to detect unusual eviction rates. Owner: infra (TBD). ETA: 4w for mitigation rollout.
Priya: 72h summary ETA confirmed: tomorrow 09:00 UTC. I'll request review from Derek and Elena once ready.
Elena: I'll draft the redaction checklist and the customer-facing policy doc by EOD +48h. If someone wants early visibility, ping me.
Derek: I'm scheduling a 20-min follow-up tomorrow 10:00 UTC to confirm owners and close ACTION-4721. Calendar invite coming.
Kudos: :thumbsup: to everyone for quick turnaround.
Priya: small ask — include contact point in the 72h summary (support@redwood.ai) and a short note on "how to request full RCA" with expected review SLA (7 business days).
Samir: added contact & SLA note to statuspage draft.
Derek: Final checklist for EOD: update ACTION-4721 with owners + ETAs, post statuspage draft (Samir), upload 72h draft (Priya), attach RCA policy draft (Elena). If anyone misses EOD, ping me in #incidents.
Elena: acknowledged.
incident-bot: ACTION-4721 status updated -> owners assigned: Priya, Samir, Elena. Due dates set.
Derek: thanks — will close the loop after the 10:00 sync.
